theme.name: Mega City Grand Prix
theme.scene: A packed street circuit through a futuristic mega city, giant screens, crowds and tight hairpins.
theme.hook_line: it's 2001. eighty thousand people screaming, one hairpin left and it's your race to lose. 🏁
thumbnail_prompts: PS1-era low-poly F1-style car on a futuristic city street circuit at dusk, giant screens and grandstands, dithered retro game render
low-poly racer crossing a checkered finish line with fireworks, fake retro HUD showing FINAL LAP and 1st place
wide shot of a tight hairpin between skyscrapers with low-poly crowds, red and gold lighting, Y2K game aesthetic

music.transitions: Continuous mix. Every track hands over to the next with an 8-bar DJ transition (tempo glide, filter sweep, impact and riser), about 11 seconds each.

youtube.description:
it's 2001. eighty thousand people screaming, one hairpin left and it's your race to lose. 🏁

Put it on for driving, gaming, coding, studying or just staring out the window pretending you're in a loading screen.

youtube.chapters_note: Timestamps assume the video starts exactly when the mix starts. If the video adds an intro, add its length to every timestamp except 00:00.

next_agent_tasks: Write 3 title options. Keep 'Y2K DnB' or 'PS1 drum and bass' in the title and lean on the theme's scene (e.g. a short second-person scenario like the hook line). Under 70 characters.
Make a 1280x720 thumbnail from theme.thumbnail_prompts and theme.palette: low-poly PS1 look, one strong focal car, high contrast, at most 3 to 4 words of text.

Make the video loop: a clean 16:9 frame of the thumbnail scene (no text or spine), then a 15s Kling 3.0 Pro clip (sound off) with that frame as BOTH start and end image. The video prompt must always ask for high speed: the car racing flat out, road markings, streetlights and scenery rushing past fast, motion blur, constant high speed. Then run the 'Mix video to YouTube' workflow with the clip URL; it fixes the seam and speeds the loop up (speed input, default 2.5x) before looping it under mix.mp3.
Make 3 vertical Shorts from audio.shorts; the drop lands at drop_hits_at_seconds, so cut visuals to it. Each Short should point to the full mix.
Use youtube.description as-is (adjust timestamps if the video has an intro) and youtube.tags.
rules: Do not use Rollcage, Psygnosis, Sony or PlayStation logos, box art or real game footage.
Do not claim the music is from or affiliated with Rollcage or any real game.
Keep the 'generated with custom Python scripts' line in the description.
